title: Certain acceptance and distribution support
statement:
Let $T$ be a nonadaptive function tester with seed distribution $
u$, and let $f$ map its domain to its alphabet. The acceptance probability of $T$ on $f$ is $1$ if and only if $T$ accepts $f$ for every seed in the support of $
u$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive function tester, with a finite seed space and a probability distribution on it
$f$ maps the tester's domain to its alphabet
